$comment: The Kleidos KiCad style, by hand: what tools/kleidos_brand/kicad.py builds the drawing sheets, the color themes and the resolved kicad/style.json from. Every length in millimeters unless its name says mil. kicad/README.md states the rules these numbers carry.

font.$comment: One typeface per drawing. null: KiCad's own lettering everywhere (kit version 1). The sheets name no face, so the sheet and the drawing always share one.

colors.$comment: Each role is the token schematic.<ground>.<role>; theme_keys lists the KiCad keys that take it. A role with no key (addition, rule) is written by a generator as an explicit color.

sheet.$comment: KiCad's default geometry, so every [page/zone] and keep-out holds: a 10 mm margin, the frame's two rectangles 2 mm apart, a zone every 50 mm counted from the margin's corner; the title block 108 x 32 mm, 2 mm inside the frame. A cell is [x0, y0, x1, y1] from the frame's inner right-bottom corner, x leftwards and y upwards.

variables.$comment: The project text variables the sheet prints, which each generator writes into its .kicad_pro.
variables.LICENSE: the SPDX identifier of the drawing

mark.$comment: brand's own PNG, placed unchanged as the sheet's bitmap: 9 mm of mark in its 18 mm cell (half the box of clear space a side, over the 6 mm print minimum). KiCad draws a bitmap pixel at 1/300 inch at scale 1.

text.$comment: KiCad's nominal size, the cap height, in mm.
